explication: Open MCT is a plugin-extensible mission-control framework for visualizing telemetry and supporting planning and operations. The principal workflow begins with an operator opening the application, navigating mission objects, and viewing them through registered visualizations; the platform also provides object/composition APIs, telemetry and time services, and persistence integrations. Plugin branches cover charts, imagery, notebooks, plans, conditions, and fault management. Relationships are limited to those shown in excerpts, the source index, or README; unsampled subsystem links are not asserted.
